entries.text: He runs a good game. I gamble to supplement my income. God knows, magic barely pays.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: Why did you lose? You could've manipulated the cards, right?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Cheat? You're asking why I don't cheat at cards?
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: Well, you could, right?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ scoffs ] of course, I could. But how would I live with myself? Who raised you?
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: Well, sir, what does any of this have to do with your twin brother... Being found decapitated at the santa monica pier?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I went to my brother for a loan. Just my luck and his.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: You found him dead of a heart attack.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: His body was still warm. Looking at him lifeless, I saw myself, my own eventual mortality. I saw all the things I meant to accomplish but didn't. It was an opportunity to vanish, to become someone else. Like I said, I'm not proud of what I did.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: And so you refrigerated the body.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I needed time to figure out how to pull it all off. Impersonating my brother, I called the Bank, told them I needed a vacation week, a trip to mexico. Then the Bank received word that I'd been in a terrible accident. It gave me plenty of time away from work.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: And you posed as an amputee... To allay suspicion that you weren't your brother.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: That, and I rather enjoy the sympathy, especially from the women in our office.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: You, uh, still haven't explained... Why you left your brother's body at the pier, or why you arranged to have his head fall off.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: He explained it. He put it so eloquently when we last spoke. It was my final performance. I wanted to go out with such a shock, such a denouement, as would forever be remembered in the annals of magic.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: That was your last performance.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What's this for?
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: Well... I still think you've got a few tricks up your sleeve.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: My god. We gave you handicapped parking. We built you a ramp.
entries.speaker: Bank Officer

entries.text: Did he have access to the vaults?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, yes. He has a key to the day gate. Several of us do.
entries.speaker: Bank Officer

entries.text: What are you looking for, Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Any hint at all... As to why Maleeni here is really impersonating his brother. What about this? Could he have removed the funds electronically?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: He didn't have security clearance for e.f.t.s-- electronic fund transfers.
entries.speaker: Bank Officer

entries.text: Maybe he got around the security. Can we check the withdrawal records?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It would require your badge number and thumbprint... And probably a federal subpoena to boot. We're extra cautious with the e.f.t.s. You can understand why. There may be an easier way. If I call up a transaction list for this terminal-- no. No, everything's in order.
entries.speaker: Bank Officer

entries.text: Mulder, it says here something about a robbery attempt yesterday.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah, that wasn't against us, but the armored transport service we deal with. No money was taken and no suspects were caught.
entries.speaker: Bank Officer

entries.text: Yeah, well, mr. Pinchbeck was the Employee who signed out the truck. He knew the schedule.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I had nothing to do with that.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: Maybe, maybe not.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We'll hold you till we find out. Make sure you don't pull a vanishing act.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ door opens, closes ] hey.
entries.speaker: Holding Cell Officer

entries.text: [ buzzing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Paul, I'm putting mr. Pinchbeck in six.
entries.speaker: Holding Cell Officer

entries.text: Right.
entries.speaker: Paul (officer)

entries.text: Sleep tight.
entries.speaker: Holding Cell Officer

entries.text: Wait. Don't I get a phone call, sir? Sir?
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: [ tapping "shave and a haircut" ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: How'd it go?
entries.speaker: Billy LaBonge

entries.text: Swimmingly.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: Abracadabra, man.
entries.speaker: Billy LaBonge

entries.text: [ grunts ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Oh, damn!
entries.speaker: Bank Officer

entries.text: Yes. Okay. All right. All right, thank you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Maleeni?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: He's still in the city lockup, where he's been since we arrested him last night. Certainly doesn't look like he did this. Lots of fingerprints.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah, I guarantee you, none of them match our thieves. They're too clever to leave clues, except for the ones they want us to find.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Excuse me. May I show you something? Hmm. We thought the security-camera footage might show the robbers.
entries.speaker: Bank Officer

entries.text: Does it?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No. They all mysteriously... Went blank from about 3:00 a.m. To 3:20, but that's not what we wanted you to see.
entries.speaker: Bank Officer

entries.text: This is from two days ago.
entries.speaker: Anthony (guard)

entries.text: Cissy Alvarez, convicted Bank robber.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You recognize this man?
entries.speaker: Anthony (guard)

entries.text: Yeah. Who is he to you?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ tapping keyboard ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ Anthony ] I know those tattoos. That's the man who tried to rob my truck.
entries.speaker: Anthony (guard)

entries.text: Aah! What the hell, man? What did I do? Yo, FBI, what's up? What's up with this, man? You can't just come bustin' in here! I got civil rights! I'm gonna call my lawyer, and then we're gonna see what's what.
entries.speaker: Alvarez

entries.text: There's nothing back there.
entries.speaker: Another Cop

entries.text: This is harassment, man. This is harassment! Yo, what are they lookin' for? Come on! Somebody talk to me!
entries.speaker: Alvarez

entries.text: [ officer ] shut up!
entries.speaker: Cop

entries.text: No, you shut up! Yo, man, this ain't right. Why you got the cuffs on so tight? Yo, will you please tell me what he's lookin' for?
entries.speaker: Alvarez

entries.text: Oh! What?
entries.speaker: Unidentified speaker

entries.text: Well. Saving up for a rainy day?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Oh, no, no, no! We got framed! This is a frame-up!
entries.speaker: Alvarez

entries.text: [ officer ] let's go.
entries.speaker: Unidentified speaker

entries.text: It was the magician!
entries.speaker: Alvarez

entries.text: The magician? Maleeni?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No, not the dead one, man! That little cabron LaBonge! LaBonge set me up! Listen to me! Listen to me!
entries.speaker: Alvarez

entries.text: Billy LaBonge.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: And the amazing Maleeni. That's a double bill I wouldn't want to miss.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Pinchbeck. You made your bail. You, too, LaBonge.
entries.speaker: Holding Cell Officer

entries.text: Okay. [ buzzing ]
entries.speaker: Paul (officer)

entries.text: I think releasing these two may be a bit premature.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ Mulder ] give us a minute. Good morning, gentlemen. Did you sleep well?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder. Agent Scully.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: Bravo. Really.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Billy LaBonge

entries.text: Last night the cradock marine Bank was robbed of $1.8 million. This morning that entire amount was found... In the possession of mr. Cissy Alvarez.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Wow. I told you he was bad news. Bravo to you. It was expeditious police work.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: Well, thank you. It was, wasn't it? It's only that Alvarez was so obviously guilty-- a convicted Bank robber caught red-handed, witnessed trying to rob an armored car just two days earlier?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: He'll need a good lawyer.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah. Yeah, he's up a creek, just like you two want him. Yeah.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I don't quite see where you're headed with this.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: I have no evidence, but I have a theory, mr. Maleeni, and, uh, I'll tell you how it goes. I think that your twin brother albert died of a heart attack, at which point, you and your young protegee saw a golden opportunity.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: My protegee? I hate this guy's guts.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: That's what you wanted us to think.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You wanted revenge against the man who made your life in prison a living hell.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I did time with you about eight years ago.
entries.speaker: Billy LaBonge

entries.text: Alvarez. You and he were on the same Cell block eight years ago.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It was a setup from the start. You played poker with him, and you made sure that you lost big.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Which gave LaBonge an in with Alvarez once everybody thought you were dead.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: LaBonge planted Alvarez's marker in Maleeni's van and made sure we found it. And then you used Alvarez's greed in order to ensnare him, and then orchestrated the attempted Bank robbery in order to implicate him.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah, that was you in the armored car disguised as Alvarez. Somehow mr. Pinchbeck got ahold of the guard's gun and switched the clip. Hold it! Guard didn't know it, but he was firing blanks.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: And then last night, the two of you robbed the Bank... And planted the money at Alvarez's place.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Don't you think we have pretty good alibis?
entries.speaker: Billy LaBonge

entries.text: You have great alibis. You have the best alibis in the world, which is why I think you two got arrested in the first place.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: With your expertise in sleight of hand, pickpocketing and escapology, I think you were both able to get out of here by pilfering a guard's key.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You could have escaped, stolen the money, framed Alvarez... And been back here in time for breakfast.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Scrambled eggs and sausage. That would be the world's greatest trick, wouldn't it?
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: One that would be forever remembered in the annals of magic.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What happens to us?
entries.speaker: Billy LaBonge

entries.text: [ Mulder ] to you? You go free, provided the magic is over.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The great ones always know when to leave the stage.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: [ buzzing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Billy, let's get the hell outta here.
entries.speaker: Maleeni/Pinchbeck

entries.text: They are the world's greatest.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We saw through their magic.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Ah, there's more. Behold. The amazing Maleeni's wallet.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You picked his pocket?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No, I pilfered it from the evidence room to prevent them from completing... Their final act of prestidigitation.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I began to wonder, why did they need so elaborate a setup? Why so high profile? Why draw the attention of the FBI in the first place?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We were the last piece of the puzzle.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yes. Framing Alvarez was just Another misdirection. This trick was about e.f.t.s, electronic fund transfers at the Bank. Maleeni, Pinchbeck, he didn't have security clearance for them, so he needed a little federal law enforcement intervention-- specifically, my badge number... And my thumbprint. With those two items they could pull off an e.f.t. And steal enough electronically... As to make that 1.8 million look like cigar-lighting money. But they can't do it without this. Pick a card, Scully. Any card.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You know, Mulder, there's still one thing that you haven't explained.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What's that?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: How the amazing Maleeni was able to turn his head completely around.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I don't know that.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I do. I'll show you. Observe.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Gee! Very nice. How'd you do that?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well... Magic.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No, seriously, Scully. How'd you do it? You know, it's not the same thing. Uh, it's different with the head. Come on, now. Look at this.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ chuckling ]
entries.speaker: Sound
